reason: I might take the free list of 15 companies just to see if they know my niche, but I would not let an agency send cold emails and LinkedIn messages to buyers in my name this month. In my business a buyer remembers who spammed him, and my reputation took twenty years to build.
objection: Your only proof is one logistics client. I sell manufactured goods for export, and a buyer who agrees to a call because of a cold email is not the same as one I meet through a partner or at a fair. I doubt those meetings turn into orders, and I worry the outreach makes us look desperate.
would_change_my_mind: A phone call with a manufacturer or exporter of my size who used the pilot and can tell me how many of those meetings became real quotes or orders.
